title: Casein kinase 2-mediated phosphorylation of the splicing factor SF3B3 plays a key role in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma progression
experiments_summary:
1. KINASE-SUBSTRATE ENRICHMENT ANALYSIS (KSEA): Performed using the R package KSEA App on previously reported large-scale proteomic and phosphoproteomic data from ESCC tissues, leveraging PhosphoSitePlus and NetworKIN databases to identify aberrantly active kinases and hyper-phosphorylated splicing factors.

2. CUSTOM PHOSPHO-ANTIBODY VALIDATION: A rabbit antibody against phospho-SF3B3 (T1200) was generated and validated by dot blot using phosphopeptide versus wild-type peptide.

3. IN VITRO PHOSPHORYLATION ASSAY: Bacterially expressed His-tagged SF3B3 (WT) and T1200A mutant were incubated with recombinant CK2 kinase (NEB) in the presence of ATP to confirm CK2-mediated phosphorylation at T1200.

4. IN VIVO CK2 INHIBITION: KYSE140 and HEK293T (transfected with GFP-SF3B3) cells were treated with the CK2 inhibitor CX-4945, followed by immunoprecipitation to measure T1200 phosphorylation and total SF3B3 protein levels.

5. CO-IMMUNOPRECIPITATION (Co-IP): Endogenous and overexpressed SF3B3 and CSNK2A1 interactions were assessed by Co-IP in ESCC cell lines and HEK293T cells using anti-FLAG, anti-GFP nanobody beads, and standard antibody-based pull-down.

6. CELL LINE PROLIFERATION AND FUNCTIONAL ASSAYS: SF3B3 was knocked down via siRNA in KYSE140 and KYSE30 cells, and overexpressed in ECA109 and KYSE520 cells. Cell proliferation (MTS assay), colony formation (crystal violet staining), wound healing, and transwell invasion assays (with Matrigel) were performed.

7. IN VIVO XENOGRAFT MODELS: KYSE30 cells stably expressing shCTL or shSF3B3, and ECA109 cells expressing control vector or SF3B3, were subcutaneously injected into BALB/c nude mice. Tumor volume and weight were monitored and measured.

8. PHOSPHORYLATION-DEFECTIVE AND PHOSPHOMIMETIC MUTANT RESCUE EXPERIMENTS: SF3B3-knockdown KYSE140 cells were reconstituted with SF3B3 (WT), T1200A, or T1200D mutants. Proliferation and colony formation assays, as well as in vivo xenograft experiments with ECA109 stable lines, were conducted to assess oncogenic function.

9. PROTEIN STABILITY AND HALF-LIFE ASSAYS: Cycloheximide (CHX) chase experiments were performed in KYSE30 cells with or without CX-4945 treatment, and in cells expressing SF3B3 WT, T1200A, or T1200D, to measure protein half-life by immunoblotting at various time points.

10. PROTEASOME AND AUTOPHAGY INHIBITION: KYSE140 and KYSE30 cells were treated with MG132 (proteasome inhibitor) or chloroquine (autophagy inhibitor) to determine the degradation pathway of SF3B3.

11. DEUBIQUITINASE SCREEN: Nuclear-localized DUBs (USP1, USP7, USP39) were identified via CPPA database correlation analysis. Each was knocked down by siRNA in ESCC cells; protein and mRNA levels of SF3B3 were assessed by immunoblotting and RT-qPCR.

12. USP7 FUNCTIONAL CHARACTERIZATION: shRNA-mediated USP7 knockdown, overexpression of USP7 WT and catalytically inactive C223A mutant, and treatment with USP7 inhibitor P5091 were used. Cycloheximide chase, MG132 rescue, ubiquitination assays (with HA-Ub and K48/K63-specific ubiquitin constructs), Co-IP, and co-immunostaining (confocal microscopy) experiments were performed to establish USP7 as a SF3B3 deubiquitinase.

13. PHOSPHORYLATION-UBIQUITINATION CROSSTALK: HEK293T cells were co-transfected with HA-Ub and GFP-tagged SF3B3 WT, T1200A, or T1200D. Ubiquitination levels were assessed by immunoprecipitation followed by immunoblotting. Co-IP was used to compare USP7 interaction with WT versus T1200A mutant.

14. NANOPORE (THIRD-GENERATION) LONG-READ SEQUENCING: SF3B3 was knocked down in KYSE140 cells; total RNA was sequenced using the Oxford Nanopore platform (SQK-PCB109, SQK-LSK109 kits; R9.4 flow cells). AS events were analyzed using the FLAIR pipeline with minimap2 alignment (|ΔPSI| ≥ 0.2, FDR ≤ 0.05).

15. ALTERNATIVE SPLICING ANALYSIS OF EXOSC2: RT-PCR on 2% agarose gels was used to detect EXOSC2 isoforms (exon 4 inclusion/skipping) following SF3B3 knockdown, rescue with SF3B3 WT or T1200A, and CX-4945 treatment. The OncoSplicing and TCGA databases were used for clinical correlation analysis.

16. SF3b COMPLEX ASSEMBLY ASSAYS: Co-IP was performed to compare SF3B3 WT versus T1200A interactions with SF3B1 and SF3B2. RNA immunoprecipitation (RIP) was used to compare binding of SF3B3 WT versus T1200A to U2 snRNA and EXOSC2 pre-mRNA.

17. EXOSC2 ISOFORM FUNCTIONAL ASSAYS: Stable KYSE140 and KYSE30 cell lines overexpressing EXOSC2-L or EXOSC2-S were generated. Proliferation, colony formation, and xenograft experiments were conducted, including rescue experiments in SF3B3-knockdown cells. RT-PCR was also performed on paired ESCC tumor and adjacent normal tissue samples (n=6) to assess isoform distribution.

18. PHARMACOLOGICAL INHIBITOR COMBINATION STUDIES: ESCC cells (KYSE140, KYSE30) were treated with CX-4945 and/or P5091 at various doses. Cell viability (MTS), proliferation, and colony formation assays were performed. Synergy was calculated using SynergyFinder 2.0. Immunoblotting and RT-PCR assessed SF3B3 protein levels and EXOSC2 splicing. In vivo, KYSE30 xenograft-bearing mice were randomized into four groups (vehicle, CX-4945, P5091, combination; n=5 per group) treated by intraperitoneal injection; tumor volume, body weight, and organ morphology/weight were monitored.

19. CLINICAL SAMPLE ANALYSIS: Protein and RNA were extracted from paired ESCC tumor and adjacent normal tissues collected from treatment-naïve patients (2015–2018). SF3B3 and EXOSC2 isoform expression were assessed; correlation with prognosis was analyzed using Kaplan–Meier survival curves and log-rank tests. CPPA database was also used for protein expression and phosphorylation correlation analyses.
